content: Actions that need the previous app frontmost must call cx.hide() first, then return Outcome::Hide (orderOut is idempotent), because acting before hide targets the Flick panel

title: Hotkeys are declared by modules (Module::hotkeys) and routed by (module,key);...
rationale: Hotkeys are declared by modules (Module::hotkeys) and routed by (module,key); keep desktop/switcher before windows in src/modules/mod.rs because registration order sets bind order and 'bound twice' error order

description: #[expect(clippy::panic)] in a #[cfg(test)] helper fails as unfulfilled expectation because clippy's panic lint does not fire in test code here
resolution: Use a bare panic! in tests, no expect attribute

description: Only Registry::dispatch and Registry::command catch panics; a panic in items/refresh/activate/hotkey takes down the launcher
resolution: Module code returns Outcome::Stay(Some(err)) on failure instead of panicking or unwrapping

content: Register a module with exactly one modules! line in src/modules/mod.rs; new module tables must be prefixed with the module id because characterization store_schema enforces it
